title: docs(ui-skills): the console guide names apps/console as the one host (#25922)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97Wh4Pf8UgMzHvahNM6Rh28)_

Part of #25922 (the governed half of the unpublish item: one guide bullet. The unpublish itself is #26483, which lands after this.)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` 里的一条要点。原文让第三方去 fork `examples/console-starter`，改成「`apps/console` 是唯一宿主」：`@object-ui/app-shell` 已是私有包，没有可 fork 的宿主模板。
- 为什么改：#26483 按裁决 6431234244 删除 `examples/console-starter`，这一行随之成为死路径，`check-skills-paths`（Test UI）会红。`ui/.claude/**` 是 Tier H 受管面，所以单独成 PR、先落地。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档一处（+5/-4），无代码；回滚 = revert。
- 先看：`ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md` 第 39 行起的那一条。
- 两分钟验证：`node ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs`，预期 exit 0（本分支与 #26483 合并后都应为 0）。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR（Tier H，GOVERNED_APPROVERS）。

## What changes

One bullet in the contributor guide's "where symbols live" note. It said third parties fork `examples/console-starter`, which wires `ConsoleShell` and host routes. It now says `apps/console` is the one host: `@object-ui/app-shell` is a private workspace package, and there is no host template to fork. A surface belongs in `app-shell` (or an app's `navigation[]` metadata) when it is shell or view code, and in `apps/console` when it is this deployment's own wiring.

## Why

#26483 deletes `ui/examples/console-starter` under ruling 6431234244 on #25922 (「本项目的组件就是为 objectos console服务的，可定制console暂时没有业务需求，可以废弃」「相关例子也可以删除」). Once it does, this line names a dead path and `check-skills-paths` reds. The file is a Tier H surface, so it lands on its own, first, and #26483 then merges `main`.

## Tests

None: a prose edit. No ablation (docs only). Publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset` (`ui/.claude/**` ships in no package).

## Verification

At `54ecffdf`, with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in this branch's own worktree:
- `node ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs`: exit 0 on this branch. The same patch applied to #26483's head gave `check-skills-paths.test.ts` 35/35 and the gate exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 12 families, each run after the last commit with its exit code captured, all exit 0; `--ran`: `12 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 12 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

## Acceptance notes
